title: Portal letter dive into a light tunnel
summary: One word on a pale page; its round letter is a live window into a blue vortex. The camera dives through it in 8 frames, then two short lines rise from depth and leave past the camera, so the tunnel reads as space.
use_when: A 3 s teaser or opener that has to feel like going somewhere, not a wipe
The hook word has a round glyph or a dot that can become a window
Naming a product after one setup line, no UI yet
A light-to-dark contrast flip to open a darker film

look.type_style: geometric grotesk; hook word medium-bold, sentence case, cap height ~11 % H; tunnel lines weight ~500, lowercase sentence case, tracking 0, ~3.5 % H, white

sfx.event: dive through the round glyph into the tunnel
setup line zooms past the camera

structure.shot: one short word, near-black on off-white, centred; its round letter is a disc showing the blue vortex inside
structure.camera: static f0-22; zoom-through about the disc centre f23-31, scale 1.00 -> ~14 (disc covers the frame diagonal)
structure.motion: disc content drifts while the word holds; zoom eased on ln(scale) with easings.inExpo, 8 fr (4 fr anticipation); outgoing letters blur 6-12 px @1080 tied to zoom speed; inner scene grows ~5x while the disc grows ~14x (parallax)

structure.shot: blue vortex with a dark hole and a lit rim crescent; a setup statement, 5 words, sets up the launch moment
structure.camera: drift: tunnel zoom ~1.2 %/s, rim light rotates ~10 deg/s
structure.motion: line already inside the disc at f28, blurred, sharp by f33 (easings.outExpo 5 fr); hold f33-51 with scale creep 1.00 -> 1.12 accelerating (easings.inExpo); exit f52-55: scale 1.12 -> 1.35, blur 0 -> 8 px, fade, 4 fr

structure.shot: same vortex; a two-word line that introduces the product by name, centred
structure.motion: enters from depth f56-60: scale 0.55 -> 1, blur 8 -> 0 px, easings.outExpo 5 fr (no overshoot seen at 30 fps); holds f60-88 while the background drifts

params.brand: any brand.json: page bg and ink for the hook word, accent drives the tunnel palette and rim light
params.content.hook: one short word containing a round glyph; split as before / after around the portal disc
params.content.setup: one setup line, <= 6 words, one line at 16:9
params.content.name: the naming line, <= 3 words
params.timing.hookHold: frames the hook word holds before the dive (default 23)
params.timing.setupHold: frames the setup line holds (default 19; raise toward 36 for readability)
params.timing.nameHold: frames the name holds at the end (default 29)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured at 30 fps: disc rest diameter 9.4 % of width; dive scale per frame f23-31: 1.00, 1.06, 1.32, 1.60, 2.10, 3.40, 7.8, 10.0, >=13, i.e. ease-in on ln(scale), not on scale. The detector cut at 0.93 s is the frame turning blue mid-dive, not a real cut. Text never fades in place: enters from 0.55 scale + blur, leaves past the camera at 1.35. Tunnel palette field #0035A2-#003ECC, hole ~#010418, rim crescent ~#1A5CFF. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed term: log-zoom (zoom eased on ln(scale)). statement-sequence hint not used: two lines only, handled by DepthPhrase.
